_about: Data for ND Composition Settings (same engine as the Character Builder, see character_builder.json for the shared fields). Generated by tools/make_composition_data.py; edit this file directly to tune wording. Option fields: text (the words in the Create text, after 'shot'), tag (Danbooru), edit (an instruction for Edit mode), cap (the caption of a panel), facing_fits (camera.orbit: the ways the body faces the camera in the Pose Builder that go with this view), deg (the angle around the subject), mutes (parameters the option switches off), explicit (needs the Explicit switch), levels / default_level (a tilt: slightly or a dutch angle). Camera presets (parameter preset.camera, macro): sets (values of other parameters), core (the ones that make the preset 'modified' when changed), sets_levels. Left and right are counted from the camera, as seen in the picture. pose.facing is never shown: the camera node fills it from the Pose Builder.
